query:
SELECT
                    COALESCE(bool_or(user_id = $2), false) AS "reporter_played!",
                    COALESCE(bool_or(user_id = $3), false) AS "reported_played!"
                FROM games_users gu
                JOIN games g ON g.id = gu.game_id
                WHERE game_id = $1 AND user_id IN ($2, $3) AND g.canceled_at IS NULL
